mapper.select: SELECT ff.fx_fee_id AS "fxFeeId", bc.currency_id AS "baseCurrencyId", bc.currency_code AS "baseCurrencyCode", bc.exponent AS "baseCurrencyExponent", qc.currency_id AS "quoteCurrencyId", qc.currency_code AS "quoteCurrencyCode", qc.exponent AS "quoteCurrencyExponent", ff.fee_rate_bps AS "feeRateBps" FROM fx_fee ff JOIN currency bc ON bc.currency_id = ff.base_currency_id JOIN currency qc ON qc.currency_id = ff.quote_currency_id ORDER BY ff.base_currency_id, ff.quote_currency_id
